title: Bottom Turtle Kubernetes - SPIRE Under Kubernetes, Not Just On Top of It
author: Claude
description: Why the strongest place to put SPIRE is beneath the cluster, chaining Kubernetes identity into a trust chain rooted in hardware.

title: The Bottom Turtle That Heals Itself - Deployment from Scratch
author: Claude
description: Building a two-server SPIRE HA trust domain from scratch on Red Hat, with ordinary packages and systemd units.

title: The SPIFFE Standard Roadmap
author: Arndt Schwenkschuster
description: The SPIFFE specification is evolving. Here is what is currently being worked on and what's ahead.

title: The Bottom Turtle That Heals Itself - Design
author: Claude
description: Building a Self-Contained, Dual-Server SPIRE HA Trust Domain from the ground up.

title: Hardening Istio security with SPIRE
author: Nathalia Satie Gomazako
description: Integrating SPIRE with Istio brings uniform, SPIFFE-based identity to service meshes by letting Envoy's Secret Discovery Service consume SPIRE identities.

title: SPIRE now runs on Windows!
author: Agustín Martínez Fayó
description: SPIRE 1.3.0 adds experimental support for running the Server and Agent on Windows, extending workload identity beyond Linux with a Windows workload attestor.

title: Enabling Authenticated Communication for Serverless Workloads with SPIRE
author: Agustín Martínez Fayó
description: Serverless platforms can't run a SPIRE Agent next to the workload. The SVIDStore plugin fixes this by pushing X.509-SVIDs to stores like AWS Secrets Manager.

title: Scrutinizing SPIRE to Sensibly Strengthen SPIFFE Security (Part One)
author: Matt Moyer
description: Part one of a security analysis of the SPIFFE Runtime Environment (SPIRE): its architecture, security properties, and a threat model for assessing attacks.

title: Scrutinizing SPIRE to Sensibly Strengthen SPIFFE Security (Part Two)
author: Matt Moyer
description: Part two scores and ranks attacks on SPIRE by impact and likelihood, finding the biggest risks stem from its centralized signing, plus low-effort mitigations.

title: SPIFFE/SPIRE move to CNCF Incubation-level hosted projects!
author: Andrés Vega
description: SPIFFE and SPIRE have moved from CNCF sandbox to incubation level. A look at the milestones, from a security self-assessment to due diligence, behind the move.

title: [Re-Cap] SPIFFE Community Day: Spring 2020
author: Umair M. Khan
description: A recap of Spring 2020 SPIFFE Community Day, the first held fully online, with 300+ attendees and deployment stories from ByteDance, Square, and Uber.

title: [Re-Cap] SPIFFE Community Day: Fall 2019
author: Umair M. Khan
description: A recap of Fall 2019 SPIFFE Community Day (200+ attendees): TPM node attestation at Bloomberg, Hadoop workloads at Uber, and SPIRE-backed service meshes.

title: [Re-Cap] SPIFFE Community Day: Spring 2019
author: Umair M. Khan
description: A recap of the May 2019 SPIFFE Community Day, hosted by Pinterest and Scytale: case studies from Uber and Square plus demos with Kubernetes, Envoy, and Istio.

title: [Re-Cap] SPIFFE Community Day: Fall 2018
author: Umair M. Khan
description: A recap of SPIFFE's seventh Community Day (November 2018): project updates, demos, and talks from Pinterest, Square, and VMware, plus Federation and JWT-SVIDs.
